leads_assigned_user_id_meeting_at_idx.name: leads_assigned_user_id_meeting_at_idx
leads_assigned_user_id_meeting_at_idx.where: "leads"."meeting_at" is not null and "leads"."assigned_user_id" is not null

reengagement_episodes_accepted_identity.name: reengagement_episodes_accepted_identity
reengagement_episodes_accepted_identity.value: "reengagement_episodes"."state" not in ('accepted_pending_record', 'accepted') or ("reengagement_episodes"."accepted_at" is not null and "reengagement_episodes"."wamid" is not null and length(trim("reengagement_episodes"."wamid")) > 0)

tenant_storefronts_active_requires_ident.name: tenant_storefronts_active_requires_identity_check
tenant_storefronts_active_requires_ident.value: not "tenant_storefronts"."active" or (nullif(trim("tenant_storefronts"."creci"), '') is not null and nullif(trim("tenant_storefronts"."legal_name"), '') is not null)

whatsapp_channels_usage_verified.name: whatsapp_channels_usage_verified
whatsapp_channels_usage_verified.value:
not "whatsapp_channels"."usage_enabled" or (
      "whatsapp_channels"."account_kind" = 'production' and "whatsapp_channels"."ownership_verified_at" is not null
      and "whatsapp_channels"."analytics_verified_at" is not null and nullif(trim("whatsapp_channels"."waba_id"), '') is not null
      and nullif(trim("whatsapp_channels"."account_timezone"), '') is not null
      and nullif(trim("whatsapp_channels"."analytics_phone_number"), '') is not null
    )

whatsapp_usage_civil_month.name: whatsapp_usage_civil_month
whatsapp_usage_civil_month.value:
date_trunc('second', "whatsapp_usage"."month_start") = "whatsapp_usage"."month_start"
      and date_trunc('second', "whatsapp_usage"."month_end") = "whatsapp_usage"."month_end"
      and date_trunc('month', ("whatsapp_usage"."month_start" - interval '1 microsecond') at time zone "whatsapp_usage"."account_timezone") = date_trunc('month', "whatsapp_usage"."month_start" at time zone "whatsapp_usage"."account_timezone") - interval '1 month'
      and date_trunc('month', "whatsapp_usage"."month_end" at time zone "whatsapp_usage"."account_timezone") = date_trunc('month', "whatsapp_usage"."month_start" at time zone "whatsapp_usage"."account_timezone") + interval '1 month'
      and date_trunc('month', ("whatsapp_usage"."month_end" - interval '1 microsecond') at time zone "whatsapp_usage"."account_timezone") = date_trunc('month', "whatsapp_usage"."month_start" at time zone "whatsapp_usage"."account_timezone")

whatsapp_usage_success_fields.name: whatsapp_usage_success_fields
whatsapp_usage_success_fields.value: ("whatsapp_usage"."free_service_volume" is null) = ("whatsapp_usage"."last_success_at" is null) and ("whatsapp_usage"."query_end" is null) = ("whatsapp_usage"."last_success_at" is null)
